name: What is the difference between a garage conversion and an addition?
description: A garage conversion reuses existing space, while an addition builds new square footage, making conversions generally faster and less expensive.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a garage conversion and an addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A garage conversion transforms an existing enclosed space, utilizing its current foundation and walls, whereas an addition involves building new square footage onto your home's footprint. Garage conversions typically have a lower cost and shorter timeline because they leverage existing structures. Additions, while offering more design flexibility, usually require new foundations, framing, roofing, and can be more complex and expensive. A practical tradeoff is that while conversions are often quicker and more budget-friendly, additions provide complete customization and potentially more expansive space.
